Crimson Desert Gameplay Tips For NEW Players - BEGINNERS GUIDE
In this video, I'm going to be showing you guys some beginner tips to begin your journey playing Crimson Desert. This is a game that does not show you everything, and a lot of things can be very overwhelming when you first start the game. So we're going to go ove like the first things that you should focus on so that you can get off to a good start.
